raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: First ignore all curved arrows. Expand Et3N as triethylamine and count its non-H bonds: 3 N–C bonds plus 3 ethyl C–C bonds = 6. Then count the main transition-state skeleton: the benzene ring contributes 6 C–C ring connections; the fused five-membered ring contributes 4 additional non-H ring connections beyond the shared fusion bond; the substituents contribute C–S, S–CH3, and C–R = 3 more. Main skeleton = 6 + 4 + 3 = 13. Total non-H bonds over all components = 6 + 13 = 19.

method.method_draft: For Et3N, sum heavy-atom degrees: N has degree 3, each of three alpha ethyl carbons has degree 2, and each terminal ethyl carbon has degree 1, so degree sum = 3 + 3×2 + 3×1 = 12, giving 12/2 = 6 bonds. For the main organic component, sum degrees excluding H: four non-fused benzene carbons degree 2 each = 8; two fused carbons degree 3 each = 6; top ring carbon attached to fused C, right ring C, and S = 3; right ring carbon attached to top C, N, and R = 3; ring N attached to fused C and right C = 2; S attached to top C and methyl = 2; methyl carbon = 1; R attachment = 1. Degree sum = 26, so main component has 13 bonds. Add Et3N: 13 + 6 = 19.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左上有“Et3N:”三乙胺标注；右侧是一个含苯并稠合环的有机过渡态结构，含有苯环、一个含N的五元环、S取代基、一个R取代基以及若干弯箭头。图中还画有N-H和一个靠近Et3N的H，但题目要求不计入涉及氢的键，并且忽略箭头。

推理：按指定方法计数。Et3N中只数重原子键：N连接3个乙基的α碳，且每个乙基还有1个C-C键，所以共有3个N-C键 + 3个C-C键 = 6个键。主有机组分用重原子度数求和：苯并稠合部分中4个非稠合苯碳各为2度，共8；2个稠合碳各为3度，共6；上方环碳连接稠合碳、右侧环碳和S，为3；右侧环碳连接上方环碳、N和R，为3；环上N连接稠合碳和右侧环碳，为2；S连接上方环碳和甲基，为2；甲基碳为1；R连接点为1。主有机组分度数和为8+6+3+3+2+2+1+1=26，因此键数为26/2=13。总键数=主有机组分13+Et3N的6=19。
